description: This file is a Python script that generates C++ header and source files for JSON-RPC API based on a JSON schema. It includes functions for creating API headers, parsing schemas, generating classes, enums, and version info, and optionally creating stubs and RPC implementations.

methods.name: CreateApiHeader(log, source_name, path, headers)
methods.description: Generates a C++ header file defining the JSON-RPC API with includes for each header in the provided list, sorted by namespace importance.

methods.name: Create(log, schema, source_file, path, additional_includes, generate_classes, generate_stubs, generate_rpc)
methods.description: Main function that parses a JSON schema to generate corresponding C++ code, including classes, enums, version info, stubs, and RPC implementations based on provided flags.
